name: nafems_le10
source: NAFEMS TNSB Rev.3 LE10 thick plate pressure. Quarter annulus: outer ellipse (3.25,2.75) m, inner (2.0,1.0) m, t=0.6 m, scaled x1/100 to mm. E=210 GPa, nu=0.3, p=1 MPa on the upper face. Symmetry cuts ux=0 (x=0) / uy=0 (y=0) via `plane` regions (node-exact product path); outer edge face ux=uy=0 on silhouette nodes (bnd_xy + elliptical radius >= 0.92 — a curved silhouette `plane` cannot express, stays manual_pins) + uz=0 on its mid-plane line. Reference sigma_yy at D=(2000,0,600) mm = -5.38 MPa; fino HEXA20 reports -5.36013.
notes: Resultant ref = p * quarter-annulus area = 1 * pi/4*(32.5*27.5-20*10) = 544.8 N. D is on the free inner edge: the top-fibre hoop compression converges from below (-3.10 -> -3.81 -> -4.33 @ pitch 0.5, ~-4.7 @ 0.4) — the staircased rim shaves the boundary peak; trend is asserted monotone toward -5.38.
